title: Zyxel security advisory (AV26-1114)
description: As of November 3, 2026, Zyxel is affected by vulnerabilities in the following products:
products:
Zyxel GS1900 series switches
	Multiple versions and models

Zyxel APs, FWA7, and Security Routers
	Multiple versions and models
solution: Review the references and apply the necessary updates.
